description: Land Use and Forest Loss by Region. What the ground of every state, province and prefecture is made of, and how it changed, counted from 30 m satellite pixels. One API for site screening, ESG and deforestation checks, urban growth, agriculture and climate apps and AI agents. Routes: /gaps (country, limit, offset); /world (thr); /nearby (lat*, lon*, radius_km, limit, offset); /classes (detail); /regions (country, q, limit, offset); /features (country, region_id, feature, limit, offset); /rankings (by, level, country, min_area_km2, min_tree_cover_km2, limit, offset); /countries (limit, offset); /regions/{id}; /countries/{code} (thr); /regions/{id}/soil; /regions/{id}/built; /regions/{id}/water; /regions/{id}/forest (thr); /regions/{id}/profile (thr); /regions/{id}/land-cover (min_km2). Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /gaps, /world, /nearby, /classes, /regions, /features, /rankings, /countries, /regions/{id}, /countries/{code}, /regions/{id}/soil, /regions/{id}/built, /regions/{id}/water, /regions/{id}/forest, /regions/{id}/profile, /regions/{id}/land-cover. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
